SELECT coin,tier,volume FROM read_coins
      WHERE activity>$1  ORDER BY tier,-volume,coin LIMIT 101

WITH selected AS (
      SELECT t.*,c.data,r.activity,(r.coin IS NOT NULL) AS eligible FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN coin_card_latest c ON c.coin=t.address AND c.coin=ANY($2::bytea[])
      LEFT JOIN read_coins r ON r.coin=t.address AND r.coin=ANY($2::bytea[]) WHERE t.address=ANY($2::bytea[])
    ), market AS (
      SELECT b.coin,(array_agg(close ORDER BY minute DESC))[1] AS price,
        (array_agg(close ORDER BY minute DESC) FILTER(WHERE minute<=to_timestamp($1::double precision-3600)))[1] AS previous1h,
        (array_agg(close ORDER BY minute DESC) FILTER(WHERE minute<=to_timestamp($1::double precision-86400)))[1] AS previous24h,
        coalesce(sum(volume_usd) FILTER(WHERE minute>=to_timestamp($1::double precision-3600)),0) AS volume
      FROM bars_1m b WHERE b.coin=ANY($2::bytea[]) GROUP BY b.coin
    ), buckets AS (
      SELECT b.coin,floor(extract(epoch FROM minute)/600) AS bucket,(array_agg(close ORDER BY minute DESC))[1] AS close
      FROM bars_1m b 
      WHERE b.coin=ANY($2::bytea[]) AND minute>=to_timestamp(floor($1::double precision/600)*600-47*600) AND minute<=to_timestamp($1::double precision) GROUP BY b.coin,bucket
    ), sparks AS (SELECT coin,array_agg(close ORDER BY bucket) AS points FROM buckets GROUP BY coin)
    SELECT t.*,t.data->'verdict' AS verdict,coalesce(bt.ts,cb.ts) AS created_at,
      b.price,b.previous1h,b.previous24h,coalesce(b.volume,0) AS volume,s.points AS spark
    FROM selected t LEFT JOIN market b ON b.coin=t.address LEFT JOIN sparks s ON s.coin=t.address
    LEFT JOIN engine_block_times bt ON bt.number=t.first_block LEFT JOIN chain_blocks cb ON cb.number=t.first_block
SELECT tier,count(*) AS n FROM read_coins WHERE activity>$1 GROUP BY tier
SELECT count(DISTINCT e.coin) AS n FROM engine_runs e JOIN read_coins r ON r.coin=e.coin WHERE e.sec>=$1 AND r.activity>$2

SELECT extract(epoch FROM to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM ts)/$4)*$4)) AS ts,
    (array_agg(open ORDER BY ts,first_block,log_index,tx_hash))[1] AS o,max(high) AS h,min(low) AS l,
    (array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC,last_block DESC,log_index DESC,tx_hash DESC))[1] AS c,sum(volume_usd) AS v,sum(trades)::integer AS trades,max(last_block) AS last_block
